book.name: Tutui laꞌeneu sososan
book.title: Tutui laꞌeneu sososan Mulai neme Manetualain Ana tao lalai no daebafok

content: Mane Masir fee Yusuf bobonggi nala dae

Basa boe ma, Yusuf no ndia tolanoo nala hataholi lima, leu lasale manek. Yusuf nalelela kasa, nae, “Ama manek! Au amang ma au kaꞌa-fadi nggala, mai leme Kanaꞌan mai so. Ala mai lo sila biꞌiae-biꞌilombo nala, sapi nala, ma basa sila bua nala. Hatematak ia sila basa sala lai dae babaꞌek Gosen so.”
Boe ma, manek natane sala nae, “Ei tataon hata?” Ala lataa, lae, “Ai ia manahoo sama leo ai bei-baꞌi nala.

Hatematak ia, nai dae Kanaꞌan fai hanan ana seli, losa taa hambu nanaꞌak ma naꞌu so. Huu ndia, de ai mini nusak ia mai, fo leo tataak. Ai boe oo mini ai banda nala. Hatematak ia, ai moke ama manek fo makamboꞌik ai leo nai dae babaꞌek Gosen, fo ai makaboi ai banda nala lai ndia.”
Boe ma, manek nafada ndia hihiin neu Yusuf, nae, “Hatematak ia, o amam ma kaꞌa-fadi mala lai ia so.

De ala bole tao nusak ia sama leo sila nusa hehelin. Au bubuluk, dae Gosen ndia, dae babaꞌek neulaun seli nai nusak ia. De malolenak, ala leo lai ele leo. Ma, mete ma neme sila mai, ala lakaneni lalelak banda no malole, na, ela ala lakaneni au enang lai ndia boe.”
Basa ndia, boe ma Yusuf nalelelak aman neu manek. Boe ma, Yakob hule-haladoi noke fo Manetualain fee babaꞌe-babatik neu manek.
Manek ndia natane Yakob, nae, “Ama teuk hida ia so?”

Yakob nataa, nae, “Au asoda teuk natun esa telu hulu ia so, ma au taa leo ahele nai mamanak esa. Au bei-baꞌi nggala leondiak boe. Mete ma nakasaman no sila, na au teung kekeꞌun lena heni sila, tehuu henuk no doidosok.”
Boe ma Yakob nateꞌa manek. Tehuu ledoeik ana bei taa laꞌo, noke Manetualain fee babaꞌe-babatik neu manek bali.

Boe ma, Yusuf tungga manek kokolan, de ana natudu fee sala mamanak nai dae babaꞌek Gosen. Mamanak ndia neulaun seli. (Dei fo ala foi mamanak ndia, nade ‘Rameses’.) Basa ndia, boe ma Yusuf aman ma ndia kaꞌa-fadi nala, leo lakandoo lai ndia.
Basa boe ma, Yusuf sadia nanaꞌak fo nakaboi aman, kaꞌa-fadi nala, ma basa sila sao-ana nala, mulai neme inahuuk losa kakana ana kala.
Fai ndoen nai Masir
Faik ndia, fai ndoen napadaka nalan seli, losa sudi nai bee, taa hambu nanaꞌak so bali. Neme Masir mai losa Kanaꞌan, hataholi la bekundole so. Taa bisa tao hata-hata so bali, huu ala ndoe lalan seli.
Basa de, hataholi la leme sudi bee mai nai Masir, ma basa mamanak nai Kanaꞌan, leu hasa nanaꞌak nai Yusuf. Boe ma, ana nakaduduluk nala basa doi kala sila, de neu mbeꞌda sala neu manek uman.

Faik ndia, hataholi Masir asa ma hataholi Kanaꞌan asa doi nala basa sala so. Huu ndia de taa bisa hasa nanaꞌak so. Basa boe ma, ala mai lasale lala Yusuf, fo loke lae, “Ama wakil aa! Fee ai nanaꞌak dei, fo boso ai mate mia ndoes. Huu ai doin basan so.”
Boe ma, Yusuf nataa nae, “Mete ma memak ei doim taa so, na, tao leoiak: fee ei banda mala mai, fo tukan neu nanaꞌak.”

Basa boe ma, ala fee sila banda nala neu Yusuf, fo ala tukan neu nanaꞌak, fo ndia sila ndala nala, sila biꞌilombo nala, sila biꞌiae nala, sila sapi nala, ma sila banda keledei nala. Huu teuk ndia, Yusuf helu leo ndiak so.

Manafali boe ma, ala fali mai sala bali leni Yusuf mai, lae, “Ama wakil aa! Ai kokolak ndoos leo. Ai doin ma ai bandan, ama ana seseluk nala basa sala so. De hatematak ia, taa hambu hata-hata so. Ela kada ai ao nala, ma ai dae nala,

de boso fee ai mate. Mete ma ai mate, na, see ndia nakaneni dae la sila? Malolenak, ama wakil haꞌi mala ai dadik ama ata nala. Ma ama boe oo haꞌi mala ai daen fo daꞌdik neu ama enan. De ama fee ai bini fo ai sele fee ama. Boe ma, ai sosotam ma ai daen ndia, ama ana nggatin no kada nanaꞌak leo, fo sadi ai boso mate!”
Huu fai ndoen ana boe napadaka, de basa hataholi Masir asa, seꞌo heni basa dae nala. De Yusuf hasa nala basa dae manai Masir, fo dadik neu manek pusakan.
No leondiak, de basa lau-inggu Masir, ala dadik manek ata nala.
Tehuu, neme basa sala mai, Yusuf taa hasa malangga anggama la dae nala, huu manek fee sala nanaꞌak nakandoo. Huu ndia, de, ala taa paluu seꞌo sila dae nala.

Faik ndia, boe ma Yusuf kokolak no lau-inggu la nae, “Hatematak ia, ei dadik manek ata nala so. Basa ei dae mala, au hasa ala sala fee manek so. De ei haꞌi mala bini la ia, fo miu sele sala leu dae la sila leo.
Boe ma, dei fo ama ketu-kolu malan, na, ei baꞌe lima kana. Babaꞌek esa feen neu manek. Ela babaꞌek haa, ei taon neu bini, ma mia ei uma isi mala miꞌa.”
Ala lataa lae, “Ama masalaꞌe mala ai so, huu ndia de ai moke makasi. Ai nau dadik ama manek ata nala leo.”

Boe ma, Yusuf tao heti-heuk ndia, dadik hadak nai nusa Masir. Huu ndia, de neme basa hade fo lau-inggu la koluk ndia, ala baꞌe lima kana. Babaꞌek esa feen neu manek, ma babaꞌek haa ala pake hehelin. Kada malangga anggama la dae nala, manek taa hasa sala. Ala pake lakandoon haꞌdak ndia.
Yusuf helu, ana natoi Yakob neu sila bei-baꞌi nala mamana laten
Mulai neme faik ndia mai, hataholi Israꞌel asa leo lakandoo lai Masir, nai dae babaꞌek Gosen. Ala dadik hataholi kamasuꞌik, ma sila numbu-saꞌdu nala boe lamanoꞌu.
Yakob bei nasoda nai Masir teuk sanahulu hitu bali, losa ndia teun basan dadik neu natun esa haa hulu hitu.

Faik fo ndia mamaten sangga deka-deka, boe ma ana noke Yusuf fo nafadan nae, “Ana Usu aa! Au ameda taa dook so, huu Manetualain noke falik au. De, au oke, fo mete ma o sue au, na o soo fo o boso matoi au nai dae Masir ia.

O musi mua falik au mbombolang neni o bei-baꞌi mala mamanan laten neu, fo matoi au nai ndia. Ndia ama hihiin ndindia.” Boe ma, Yusuf nataa nae, “Hei, ama! Mete ma ama nau leondiak, na, kada au tungga leo.”

Boe ma, Yakob kokolak nae, “Mete ma, leondiak na, hatematak ia o soo dei, fo mae o tungga ama hihiin.” Basa boe ma, Yusuf soo tungga Yakob kokolan ndia. Boe ma, Yakob sendek lunggulanggan neu koi lain, de ana hule-haladoi noke makasi neu Manetualain.

footnotes.text: Hambu susula dedeꞌa Ibrani boe, nae, “Yusuf huꞌa basa hataholi la leni kota dale leu.”
